turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Liew, the anesthesiologist. I'll be speaking with you today about your upcoming surgery. Can you tell me a bit about why you're having this TURP done?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Ah, yes doctor. My prostate been swollen for a while, causing trouble urinating. Sometimes I can't go at all, very uncomfortable. Urologist said TURP is the best option lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: I see. Let's go over your medical history. Can you list all your current medications for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Sure. I take amlodipine 10mg every day for blood pressure, lisinopril 20mg also daily. Metformin 500mg twice a day for diabetes, atorvastatin 20mg at night for cholesterol, and aspirin 75mg daily. Oh, and omeprazole 20mg, but I stopped that two weeks ago as instructed.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you. Do you have any known allergies, Mr. Tan? The records say 'no known allergies,' but I'd like to confirm directly.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Allergies? Hmm... I think I had a reaction once to penicillin when I was younger. Got a rash all over, very itchy. But that's all, I think.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Ah, that's important. Was it specifically penicillin, or other antibiotics too?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Only penicillin, doctor. My skin turned red and itchy like a heat rash. Never had issues with other antibiotics.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Noted. Let's move to your health conditions. You have hypertension, diabetes, high cholesterol, and stage 2 kidney disease. Are these well-controlled?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, my BP usually around 130/80, sugars okay with metformin. Cholesterol under control with statin. Kidneys stable, no recent issues.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Have you eaten or drunk anything this morning? Remember, nothing after midnight except clear fluids up to 2 hours ago.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doctor. Only sipped some water this morning, stopped by 6am. Followed the instructions strictly.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Have you had anesthesia before? Any reactions or complications?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, once for cataract surgery. They gave spinal anesthesia then too, no problems at all. Woke up fine.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Lastly, how's your overall energy and mobility? Can you walk comfortably, climb stairs?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Still walking daily, but slower now. Prostate issues make it hard sometimes, but I manage stairs with rest stops.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. We'll proceed with spinal anesthesia plus local infiltration as planned. No contraindications noted. Any questions for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doctor. All clear. Thank you for explaining everything.
